svg.aria-label: LTX-2 IC-LoRA training graph: frozen base, LoRA on attention and feed-forward linears in all 48 blocks, one-way reference attention
svg.text: LTX-2 IC-LoRA — the default training graph: what is frozen, where LoRA trains
Recipe of ctt_v2 → ctt_v3 → dualforce_control (store/runs/002, 008, 012) · LTX-2 19B dev · one-way reference attention · LoRA r=128 α=128 on attn1 + attn2 + FF in every block
① Inputs → one token sequence (training layout [ reference | target ])
reference = demo latents, in front · same 16×20×15 grid → M = N = 4800
start / end = clean target latents pinned by the mask (cond_clean_latents)
middle = noised, x = (1−σ)·x₀ + σ·ε — the only supervised tokens
one shared projection for reference · start · middle · end tokens
+ RoPE (t, h, w) · reference tokens reuse the target's own grid
token role is carried by σ and the attention split — not by position
shift / scale / gate for attn1 & FF, computed PER TOKEN (σ=0 tokens modulate as clean)
② One transformer block (video stream) · × 48 · d 4096 · 32 heads × 128 · FF 16384
cross-attention attn2 — text only (no adaLN, no gate: cross_attention_adaln = off)
→ shift / scale / gate for attn1 and FF
audio stream: audio_attn1/2 + a2v / v2a cross-attn
present in the 19B checkpoint, disabled here
Loss: flow-matching MSE ‖ v̂ − (ε − x₀) ‖² averaged over loss_mask = the middle tokens only.
Reference / start / end predictions are computed but discarded — no gradient flows from them.
LoRA sits on 10 linears per block: attn1 q·k·v·out · attn2 q·k·v·out · ff.net.0.proj · ff.net.2.
Everything else in the block is frozen (norms, adaLN tables) or parameter-free (RoPE, SDPA, GELU, gates).
③ LoRA on one linear (PEFT) ④ What trains, what never does
y = W x + (α/r) · B A x
init: A random, B = 0 → starts as the base model
only A and B receive gradients
LoRA targets — identical in all 48 blocks
attn1.to_q · to_k · to_v · to_out.0 attn2.to_q · to_k · to_v · to_out.0
10 linears × 48 blocks = 480 adapted linears · 960 tensors (A, B)
654.3 M trainable params → 1.31 GB bf16 checkpoint ≈ 3.4 % of the 19B base
r = 128 · α = 128 · dropout 0 · lr 1e-4 · WSD · effective batch 8
scale_shift_table (every block + output) · all norms · proj_out · audio stream

Verified 2026-08-28 against src/LTX-2-dualforce (ltx-core: model.py, transformer.py, attention.py, feed_forward.py, adaln.py; ltx-trainer: flexible.py, trainer.py) and the store/runs/012 checkpoint (960 LoRA tensors, 48 blocks).
Inference concatenates [target | reference] instead of [reference | target]; the one-way rule is identical. Token counts (M = N = 4800) are the ctt_v2 training geometry (16 latent frames × 20 × 15).
